scenario.summary: Signed in with the sheet account, adds a simple product, a configurable variant and a grouped product (quantity 5 each), checks out with Custom Flat Rate and COD, then tracks the new order on Check Order Status (order number + account email) and checks Create Return is shown.
steps: Search the simple SKU, open it, quantity 5, Add to Cart
Search the configurable parent, pick variant z-2510001's attributes, quantity 5, Add to Cart
Search the grouped SKU, child quantity 5, Add to Cart
Cart > Checkout, Custom Flat Rate, COD, Complete Purchase; read the order number
Footer Check Order Status: order number + the account's email (its username), Get Order Details
stateChanges: Order placed by the test (created-by-test, not deleted)
assertions: Create Return link visible on the tracked order
evidence: No dependsOn: the class runs by priority and shares the class field orderNumber. Methods 1-3 (priority 1-10, named 'ForRetailUser') sign in with the sheet account returnOrderGuestUserTest, place an order and work on it; methods 4-10 (priority 15-45) place a guest order and work on it. First method captures: method 1 declares the retail chain's records, method 4 (returnOrderForGuestUserVerifyCreateReturnButtonVisibleAfterTrackingOrder) the guest chain's; later methods read the class fields (SkipException DATA_UNAVAILABLE when null).

DECLARED ACCOUNT (per method): the method signs in, or works in the session signed in earlier in the class, with the sheet account testClassRetailUsers/returnOrderGuestUserTest (loginAndRegistration!B174/C174). user = USER_WEBSTORE_REGISTERED {store MaxwellsHardware}, preferred {source: the username source, required: true}, declared at method start with Tda.declareUser (useExisting); username/password stay credential sources (masked) the test keeps reading from its sheet.
Check Order Status takes the account username as the email address (credential source, usedBy addEmailAddress).

Products (sheet columns, tda rows): simple z-2420004 'Black + Decker 2.4 Amp Corded 5 in Random Orbit Sander' (Simple, DontTrackInventory; column AddonCheckboxAsOptional, the optional add-on is not selected) -> PRODUCT_SIMPLE_IN_STOCK {quantityUsed 5, minMaxQuantity 5}, as the approved Selenium shoppingCart entry; configurable B-100000 with variant z-2510001 (picked by selectConfigurableAttributes from the variant's attribute columns, not scanned -> variant1Attr1..3) -> PRODUCT_CONFIGURABLE_WITH_VARIANTS {quantityUsed 5, minVariants 1, minAddOns 0, minPersonalizableAttributes 0, variantAttributes BulbSize,Color,Technology} (outputs parentProductSku, variant1Sku, variant1Name); each preferred its sheet SKU (not required). Quantities 5 -> config.

grouped: z-2200003 (column VacuumPump), setGroupProductQuantity sets the child quantity 5 -> PRODUCT_GROUPED_IN_STOCK {quantityUsed 5, minAddOns 0, minPersonalizableAttributes 0}, preferred the sheet SKU (not required). The key has no maximum-quantity param: a fallback product whose MaximumQuantity is below 5 would fail at Add to Cart.

shipping/payment: checkout selects Custom Flat Rate (shippingMethod.select/clickCustomFlatRateShipping, code FLAT) and Charge on Delivery (paymentMethod.clickCODPaymentOption) -> read-only precondition needs SHIPPING_FLAT_RATE_ON_STORE {FLAT, countries us (assumption, as the approved Playwright order-receipt entries)} and PAYMENT_COD_ON_STORE.

REVIEW (Create Return, order eligibility): the order is placed by the test (created-by-test) and Check Order Status must offer Create Return on it. On atstage Create Return was NOT offered on freshly placed orders (Playwright my-account order-history step 6 parked and order create-return known failure, memory 2026-11-02/04: shown when the store's EnableReturnRequest is on, enabled by Znode_GetValidateReturnOrderProduct line states/RMA window). This is not data the resolver can supply; the proposed STORE_WEBSTORE_RETURNS_ENABLED key (deferred by the user 2026-11-04) would only check the store setting.

returnsStore: STORE_WEBSTORE_RETURNS_ENABLED {store MaxwellsHardware} (new key, pending, user decision 2026-11-11): the store must serve a webstore and have the store global attribute EnableReturnRequest (ZnodeGlobalAttribute 1076) = true, the setting that makes Create Return available. It guarantees the store setting only; whether the order this test places is eligible (line states SHIPPED/SUBMITTED, RMA window, not already returned; Znode_GetValidateReturnOrderProduct) is decided per order and is NOT guaranteed. DB 2026-11-11 (tda rows): MaxwellsHardware (PortalId 7) has EnableReturnRequest = false (ZnodePortalGlobalAttributeValueLocale 57, modified 2026-10-31), so readiness reports GAP ZERO_ROWS: this explains the missing Create Return on atstage; the store setting must be switched on (admin, not TDA) before these tests can pass.
Store: openWebstoreUrl opens automation_webStoreUrl (atstage: webstore-z10-atstage, the main store MaxwellsHardware), the same store as the Selenium pdp/quickOrder/plp/home entries.
Profile: work/profiles/profile.json has no observations for these Selenium cells (profiled false); DB facts from bin/tda rows (2026-11-11) where cited.
Scanned constant values (locators, report messages, map keys, delays, regex) are framework constants: role config, no need.
migrate: Selenium reads Excel tables through TestData.getMap / getHashMap; there is no swap for Selenium.
Baseline 2026-11-11 (no agents): this test fails at Create Return / the return page, so it keeps the returnsStore need.
